review_description: Celtic Solar provided and installed a quality product professionally, competitively priced and all electrical work carried out to the utmost of high standard.

I contacted Local family company Celtic Solar to give me options a for a solar system.Tony and Melinda were prompt and gave great options for different sized systems to suit my requirements. The ordering of the system and installation were prompt and of very high quality.Total safety was exercised at all times and the grid connection process has been awesome.
I needed a lot of guidance and options because of peculiar circumstances and most of the other installers were one trick ponies.  Celtic gave me flexible options.
Better communication of the process associated with the installation and post installation would have been helpful.
Can be confusing! Your website was educating make easier to sort information.

Tony from Celtic solar has spent a lot of time and research to find the best quality solar for a competitive price.  His explanations made it simple for us to compare and understand how solar works, I definitely recommend him to anyone who wants a system that works to its maximum potential.
